newsitem.title: UK: BP's French refinery still for sale.
newsitem.headline: BP's French refinery still for sale.

text.p: British Petroleum Co Plc said on Monday that efforts to sell its Lavera refinery in the south of France continue despite its failure to find a buyer for a similar loss making plant in the United States.
"We are still talking to a number of interested parties and the data room for the refinery is still being visited," said a spokesman for the company.
BP's refineries at Lavera in France and Lima in Ohio were put up for sale in January in a move to limit exposure to worldwide refining overcapacity.
The company received three bids for the Ohio plant but all were unacceptable and it will stop operating the 161,000 barrels-per-day plant as an oil refinery in two years.
In August chief executive John Browne said "we set a target to get into a healthy position by the end of this year and that is unchanged."
